integrity: Analytic proof and supplementary reproducible code; no independent audit and no claim of established publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the two-dimensional upper-triangular drift with positive-definite correlated diffusion and identity stationary covariance; no classification of arbitrary higher-dimensional drifts. General second-quantization products and Gramian leading constants are known; novelty is the combined sharp shear extremum and coupled ellipticity-edge limit.
title: Nonnormal Schatten amplification and ellipticity-edge crossover for planar inverse Ornstein–Uhlenbeck semigroups
